messages:
sam_release: Kicking off the v2 gradual canary now for EU/NA. Rolling to 10% first, then 30% and 60% per schedule. Start time 2025-04-12 15:00 UTC. Putting surge protection and caps in place. ping @maria_ops @oliver_sre for rollback criteria and monitoring setup.

maria_ops: Ack. On-call covered. Clarify surge policy: per-shard rate cap or global?

sam_release: Per-route/shard caps: 12r/s per shard, global burst 100r/s. Rollback triggers: p95 latency > 400ms OR error rate > 0.7% for 3 consecutive 5-min buckets. Also abort if mobile SDK client-error signatures spike.

deploy-bot: deploy started: v2 canary -> 10% traffic (routes: textgen, chat, embeddings). playbook: /playbooks/v2-rollout.md

kate_client: fyi mobile SDK 1.4.2 has been observed to double-encode a header in a staging run. Can we pin mobile clients to v1 for the first hour of the canary?

oliver_sre: We can add a header gate for `x-client-sdk=mobile` to force route -> v1. Low risk. Will need the gateway rule and audit.

maria_ops: Agree to pin for 60m then reassess. Who will flip the gate? @deploy-bot?

sam_release: I'll request it. @deploy-bot please apply header-pin rule: header `x-client-sdk: mobile` -> route v1, ttl 3600s. Please log to rollout channel.

deploy-bot: pin rule applied: header-pin:v1 x-client-sdk=mobile ttl=3600s. Audit id: audit_20250412_001

qa_bot: smoke results: initial 10% verified. p95=88ms, errors 0.05% across routes. No client signature spikes detected.

kate_client: thanks. I'll throttle beta SDK distribution and notify partner apps to watch for header issues.

oliver_sre: also adding watch for KV cache hitrate — if hitrate drops >15% we should pause to avoid CPU surge from cache misses.

maria_ops: alert created: `kv_cache_hitrate_drop > 15% sustained 10m` -> action: pause canary. Manual operator pause key enabled.

sam_release: Rollout schedule: 10% now, 30% at +30m, 60% at +90m. If any trigger fires -> full rollback to v1.

kate_client: :thumbsup: I'll stand by to cut an SDK quickfix if we see header encoding regressions.

oliver_sre: Suggest a soft-fail fallback: if v2 responds 5xx, gateway retries once to v1 for the same request to reduce user impact. Thoughts?

sam_release: Good idea. @deploy-bot add a fallback retry policy: on 5xx -> immediate retry to v1 once. Make sure metrics show retries.

deploy-bot: fallback retry policy added: on 5xx -> retry to v1 once. Config id: cfg_20250412_fallback_01

maria_ops: Sounds good. We'll only escalate if thresholds are hit. I'll draft a short note for release notes once we hit 60%.

qa_bot: monitoring channel -> #rollout-1738881234. All green at +12m.

sam_release: Closing for now. If anything anomalous, ping me directly. Thanks team.
